title: Akutou Ikka No Mana Musume, Tensei Saki Mo Otome Game No Gokudou Reijou Deshita. - Saijoukyuu Rank No Akuyaku-Sama, Sono Dekiai Wa Fuyou Desu!
description: After her sudden death at the hands of an assassin, the former granddaughter of a Yakuza boss reincarnates in a otome game as the heroine. The game is, of course, set in the time of early European mafia (but with magic and other special abilities somehow), specifically a kingdom where the royal family is supported behind the scenes by five major gangster! Please God, whyyy, I only wanted to life a normal life! A dangerous love game between a former Yakuza heiress and her villain fiancé begins! Akutou Ikka No Mana Musume, Tensei Saki Mo Otome Game No Gokudou Reijou Deshita. – Saijoukyuu Rank No Akuyaku-Sama, Sono Dekiai Wa Fuyou Desu!, Akumana, Akutou Ikka no Mana Musume, Tensei Saki mo Otome Game no Gokudou Reijou deshita., あくまな, 悪党一家の愛娘、転生先も乙女ゲームの極道令嬢でした。, 悪党一家の愛娘、転生先も乙女ゲームの極道令嬢でした。～最上級ランクの悪役さま、その溺愛は不要です！～@COMIC
